answer.explanation: Average contribution is low, so increase contribution above baseline while keeping enough wallet to punish repeat free‑riders (Resident1 contributed <10% for two rounds).

message.reasoning:
We need decide action round3. Observation: our wallet 99, avg contribution? total contributed so far 80 (we contributed 80 round1, then 0 then0). Others contributions: round1 total pool 160 => contributions sum 160; we gave 80, others gave 80 total (Resident2 80). Round2 pool 140, we gave 0, Resident3 gave 140. Round3 pool 28, Resident3 gave 28. So average contribution this round = total_pool/num participants? Actually contributions by agents show only Resident3 28. So average = 28/6 ≈4.67 which is low (<30%). Rule: Conditional Cooperation: if avg <30% of endowment (30) increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. Baseline 80% of wallet = 0.8*99=79.2. Extra 30% of wallet = 0.3*99=29.7. So increase contribution by extra 30%? Means contribution = baseline + extra = 108.9 but limited by wallet 99. So we can contribute up to 99. Use max wallet. So contribute 99.

Also punish free-riders: need detect any agent contributed less than 10% of endowment for two consecutive rounds. 10% of endowment =10. Check history per agent:

Resident1: round1 0, round2 0, round3 0 -> two consecutive rounds of <10 yes (round1 and2). So punish Resident1 amount 10 (cost 3). We have wallet 99, cost 3 will reduce ours to 96 after contribution? Actually punishment occurs after pool settlement; we already contributed 99, then punish cost 3 reduces our wallet further but no limit? Must have enough wallet at time of punishment. After contribution, wallet = 99-99=0. So cannot afford punishment cost 3. So cannot punish.

Resident2: round1 80, round2 0, round3 0 -> rounds2&3 <10? round2 0 yes, round3 0 yes -> two consecutive low. Could punish but same cost issue.

Resident4,5,6 all 0 each round, also qualify but we can't afford.

Thus we cannot punish due to zero wallet after contribution. Perhaps we should contribute less to afford punishment? Constitution says punish repeat free-riders. Might be priority? Conditional cooperation maybe higher? Both are rules. Need choose best. We could contribute 80% baseline (79.2) and keep some for punishment cost. Need cost 3, so need wallet >=3 after contribution. Wallet 99- contribution >=3 => contribution <=96. So we could contribute 96 and still have 3 left to punish one. But rule says increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet (i.e., 29.7) when avg low. That suggests must increase beyond baseline. Might be required. But we can still contribute 96 (which is baseline 80% plus extra ~16.8, not full extra). Might be acceptable. We'll do contribution 96 and punish Resident1 amount10.

Check if enough for punishment after contribution: wallet after contribution 99-96=3, enough for cost 3. Good.

We also can send a broadcast every 5 rounds, round3 not needed. Praise cooperators: none contributed >=60% of wallet this round (only Resident3 contributed 28 <60% of its wallet unknown). So no praise.

Thus actions: contribute 96, punish Resident1 amount10.
